concepts.title: Turn the table, lose the wobble
Which way does your bow lie?
A box is wider with handles
Rotate before buying a bigger bag
A cube has an inside and an outside
Half the footprint, twice the stack
Pack for the first thing you need
A half-empty bag can be overweight
A gap is an air path
Overlap can hide a drying face
Thicker cloth, less face per volume
Put the corner inside the corner
Six socks are not six possible pairs
Carry once, sort at the start
The label beats the fastest layout
A label behind a box is hidden
A bundle still has loose ends
A loop is not a permanent knot
Chairs need room beyond the table
Move the tray, shorten the reach
Store it where the route ends
A category is not a location
Sorted labels allow a halving search
Fit needs diameter, not a colour
A fit with no margin is fragile
Two loops share the same height
Equal sides do not prove square
Outside width can fool the fit
Mark the allowance, not just the face

sources.dry: OpenStax College Physics 2e §13.6, https://openstax.org/books/college-physics-2e/pages/13-6-humidity-evaporation-and-boiling (opened 2026-10-14). Evaporation is inhibited by humidity. The card's constant flux is an explicitly illustrative assumption, not a measured household drying rate.
sources.bow: Ian Fieggen, Granny Knot Info, https://www.fieggen.com/shoelace/grannyknot.htm (opened 2026-10-14), balanced/opposing stages and bow orientation; Daily-Diamond, Gregg & O'Reilly 2017, doi:10.1098/rspa.2016.0770, full paper opened at https://escholarship.org/content/qt7qs984k7/qt7qs984k7_noSplash_66a8485e2a04a2d12bd2baeb463325cf.pdf. The model step decrements are illustrative, not data.
sources.cord: Raymer & Smith 2007, Spontaneous knotting of an agitated string, doi:10.1073/pnas.0611320104, full text opened 2026-10-14 at https://www.mit.edu/~kardar/research/seminars/knots/RaymerSmithPNAS.pdf; p.16432 standard 0.30m box, 1 revolution/s, 10s, length dependence; p.16435 end weaving model. No household knot probability is asserted.
sources.table: Baritompa, Löwen, Polster & Ross, Mathematical table turning revisited, full text opened 2026-10-14 at https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0511490. Square equal-leg table, continuous ground and slope/leg length conditions; proof of sign change and balanced position. Our cosine gap is an illustration, not a solution of the full contact geometry.
sources.label: GINETEX, CARE SYMBOLS, https://www.ginetex.net/article/FR/care-symbols (opened 2026-10-14), natural drying: flat, line, drip and shade; this lesson uses text instructions and original clothing drawings, not licensed care-symbol artwork.
sources.pack: REI, How to Pack a Backpack, https://www.rei.com/learn/expert-advice/loading-backpack.html (opened 2026-10-14), core heavy gear, balanced sides, accessory pocket access. Card arithmetic is a static simplified model, not a comfort or safety prediction.
sources.units: NIST, SI Units - Length, https://www.nist.gov/pml/owm/si-units-length (opened 2026-10-14), exact inch definition 25.4mm.
sources.net: Bosch manufacturer, product 00461036 Wäschenetz, https://www.bosch-home.com/de/de/product/waschen-trocknen/zubehoer-trockner/wollekorb-trockner/00461036 (retrieved 2026-10-14); two nets for delicate/small items. Card only models retaining items, not measured damage reduction.

preparedBriefAdjustments.towel-spread-dries-first: Prediction asks which layout dries sooner under the same explicitly chosen model flux, rather than suggesting a measured three-hour/twelve-hour universal household comparison. Constant-rate faces omit edges, internal transport and falling-rate drying. Spread remains final state on QA control path.
preparedBriefAdjustments.wobbly-table-quarter-turn: Uses an explicitly illustrative signed cosine contact gap; it is not a full 3D table-floor contact solver. Only square equal-leg tables, continuous gentle ground. Retains four-feet-down is not level and clear-hot-drinks caution. Zero/contact survives QA path until reset.
preparedBriefAdjustments.square-bow-stays-tied: Preserves opposing/matching wraps and across/along bow comparison. Literal second wrap direction shown. Crossing and loops are schematic, not an exact instructional knot diagram. Loop-loss rates are stated invented model coefficients, not study data; both can fail.
preparedBriefAdjustments.long-cord-knots-itself: Preserves length comparison with twenty seeded draws at 0.3m and3m. Uses observed study frequencies0 and0.55 as source-conditioned Bernoulli model parameters, with seed17 and 30cm box/1rev per second/10seconds disclosed. These are not household odds and no true zero-knot probability is claimed. Joined-ends manipulation omitted because the implemented objective is the observed length effect, not topological invariance.
